name: 整列頁首（不固定）＋標誌左、導覽與功能區右，滑過展開大型面板
desc: 跟著頁面捲走的整列頁首，下緣有分隔線，導覽連結與功能區之間有直向分隔線；有子項目的導覽連結滑過後，在頁首下方展開橫跨全寬、左欄加右側多欄的大型面板。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，跟著頁面捲動，不固定：標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，所有元素垂直置中排成一列；標誌與功能區分別靠近畫面左右邊緣，只保留少量邊距，比頁面內容寬度更寬。功能區可放小型文字連結與一個圖示按鈕，沒有時省略；有功能區時，導覽連結與功能區之間有一條直向分隔線。頁首下緣有一條橫跨全寬的分隔線。導覽項目有子項目時，滑過後展開橫跨頁首寬度的大型面板，內含多欄連結：面板從頁首下緣展開、疊在下方內容上，內容對齊頁面內容寬度；左欄放面板標題，下方可放直向排列的分類清單（每項下方有分隔線，目前項目強調），左欄底部可放一排小圖示連結與小型文字連結；左欄和右側之間有一條直向分隔線；右側可放小標題與多欄文字連結，或並排的附圖小卡片、橫幅卡片與按鈕，沒有時省略；面板右上角有關閉按鈕。
mobile: 頁首上留標誌在左，右側留功能區的一個小型文字連結與一個圖示按鈕，最右側是選單按鈕；頁首下緣的分隔線保留，仍然跟著頁面捲動，不固定。導覽連結收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，導覽連結直向排列；有子項目時點擊後在原位展開。觸控裝置上取消滑過展開的大型面板。

en.name: Non-fixed header bar with logo left, navigation and actions right, mega panel on hover
en.desc: A full-width header bar that scrolls away with the page, with a divider along its bottom edge and a vertical divider between the navigation links and the actions group; hovering a navigation link with sub-items opens a full-width mega panel below the header with a left column and multi-column content on the right.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, which scrolls away with the page, with the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, all vertically centered in one row; the logo and the actions group sit close to the left and right edges of the viewport with only a small margin, wider than the page content width. Optionally place small text links and one icon button in the actions group; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements; when the actions group is present, a vertical divider separates the navigation links from it. A divider spans the full width along the bottom edge of the header. When a navigation item has sub-items, hovering it opens a large panel spanning the width of the header with multiple columns of links: the panel opens from the bottom edge of the header and overlays the content below, with its content aligned to the page content width; the left column holds the panel heading, optionally followed by a vertically stacked category list (a divider below each item, the current item emphasized), and optionally a row of small icon links and a small text link at the bottom of the left column; a vertical divider separates the left column from the right side; the right side optionally holds a small heading with multiple columns of text links, or side-by-side small cards with images, a wide banner card and buttons, omitted when there is no content; a close button sits in the top-right corner of the panel.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: The header keeps the logo on the left, one small text link and one icon button from the actions group on the right, and the menu button at the far right; the bottom divider is kept, and the header still scrolls away with the page. The navigation links move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport, with the navigation links stacked vertically; items with sub-items expand in place when tapped. The hover-opened mega panel is removed on touch devices.
